headline: Fable February 23 2027
title: Fable Release Date February 23 | Playground Games Reboot | Gaming News
video_script: Fable finally has a release date. The fantasy reboot from Playground Games, the studio behind Forza Horizon, launches on February twenty third, twenty twenty seven. It was announced at the Xbox Games Showcase and comes to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, and PC. It was delayed from twenty twenty six. Are you ready to return to Albion? Comment below!
description: Fable (Playground Games) launches February 23, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC after a delay from 2026. Sources: Video Games Chronicle, Shacknews, Push Square.
